title: Expanded record format 1.0.0, policy-succession validation profile 1.0.4
description: Preserves 1.0.3 and adds qualified directed instrument policy succession.

source_vote_categories.description: Verbatim source labels and counts with exact same-result evidence; no automatic category mapping or denominator inference.

source_vote_totals.description: Verbatim source labels and counts with exact same-result evidence; no automatic category mapping or denominator inference.

reporting_scope.description: Optional explicit geographic coverage of this result observation. Missing legacy scope is not presumed to cover the whole electorate.

instrument.description: For policy_successor_adopted, the adopted successor instrument.

action.description: Source-supported event kind; original expected term endpoints do not establish actual expiry. Events do not automatically update current legal force.

related_instrument.description: For policy_successor_adopted, the related policy predecessor of the adopted successor named by instrument.

qualification.const: Policy succession does not establish formal termination, overlap, or current force.

citation_url.description: Reviewed durable public citation; acquisition url/body/text hashes remain the evidence identity.
